parameterized_queries.purpose: Read byte offset 0, the NVM map revision byte used by get_map_details. One numeric argument consumed by UDW numeric-reader virtual method.
Print physical NVM size, then all bytes. Handler obtains size from A0261BD8 and loops A0261BE2 one byte at a time; no arguments and no writes.
parameterized_queries.caveat: May take significantly longer than ordinary queries because each byte is a separate NVM read. Keep exact output locally; it may include device configuration.

physical_interruption.observed: ASSERT 0xC4EB99F7, hw_micci2.c line 1733, while executing tShell; no prompt.
physical_interruption.user_context: User subsequently stated they unplugged the printer, restarted it, and returned to command mode. Timing relationship is uncertain; this record does not establish a deterministic command defect.

decoded_transaction.evidence: A0172E0C loads 0x7D; A0171A3C..A0171A56 constructs command; A0171A74 tests controller+0xA6 bit 1 and A0171A82..A0171AA2 constructs fault code from command>>4.

physical_interruption.assert_loop: A0009FBC periodically reprints the assertion (10,000,000 timer ticks); normal UART shell no longer runs. Default final fault hook A0009F62 spins at A0009F66. Fault UI callback polls physical keys; no UART recovery parser was found.
physical_interruption.future_handling: Only retry after stable power and confirmed shell. The command queries carriage companion hardware, so keep it separate from pure metadata batches.
